t: There's no church here to see now. This was the site of St Mary Mounthaw, a medieval parish church on Old Fish Street Hill in the City of London. It had a close association with the Bishops of Hereford, and it was destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666 and never rebuilt. Edward Foxe, Bishop of Hereford, was buried here in 1538. He played a major role in Henry the Eighth's divorce from Catherine of Aragon, and helped draft the Ten Articles of 1536.
